what: Each press of a dark pill like a notch at the top of the screen moves to the next state (idle → recording collapsed → recording expanded → idle) — the current content fades out with 10px blur · .7x scale · transparent in .3s easeInOut, the pill grows or shrinks to the new content size in .45s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.1,1), and the new content comes into focus .2s later over the same length. While recording, a timer (min:sec) runs from the first press and waveform bars rise and fall

options.lag: Delay before new content settles in (s), default .2
options.ease · size-ease: Curve, default 0.42,0,0.58,1 · 0.4,0,0.1,1 (sine.inOut · power3.out if CustomEase is missing)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-r: Resting pill width, height and bottom corner radius (style), default 170px · 40px · 16px
options.[data-fx-part=state]: One per state, in order — data-state="none" Is an empty cell with no motion (rest)
options.[data-fx-part=timer] · [data-fx-part=wav: (optional) min:sec timer · waveform where bars i rise and fall
options..is-fx-on: Attached to the panel while recording

note: The original uses framer-motion layout, so it stretches the pill size with transform and counter-corrects the inside — the part changes width and height directly. The size curve .45s (.4,0,.1,1) is a value read from framer’s default layout transition

from.where: index.html .am-laptop — original index notch demo (motion.div layout · AnimatePresence mode=wait · initial/exit blur(10px) scale .7 opacity 0 · animate delay .2 · transition .3 easeInOut · bottom corners 16)
